subject: RSW_Neebray

reply.subject: RSW_Neebray

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South is a front view of a round red-orange body with a pale belly and a wide mouth full of sharp teeth. It has a row of small dark eyes on the brow, two large pale-blue veined translucent wings spread to the sides, and two small fins showing above and behind the head. East is a side profile of the same body: the head faces right, the mouth is open with teeth, there are several eyes along the brow, and a short tendril hangs under the jaw. One large translucent wing sweeps up and back, the far wing shows below the body, and a small forked pair of tail fins sits at the rear. North shows the rounded back with mottled red skin, no face, both wings spread and a pair of small blue tail fins hanging at the bottom centre. Palette and rendering match across all three.
observed.south.png: Front view at full resolution: a fleshy, wrinkled red head and body, a gaping mouth with a red tongue and needle teeth, six small dark eyes in a row across the brow, and a small tendril stub under the chin. The belly is lighter beige. The two big translucent blue-grey veined wings are spread, the small tail fins peek up behind the head, and the edges are painterly with no heavy outline.
observed.east.png: Side profile: a stout, tapering body with a head like a fish or amphibian, an open toothed mouth, about four or five eyes visible along the brow and a tendril stub under the jaw. The large translucent wing is raised back, the far wing shows below, and the rear ends in two small translucent tail fins. The skin is wet and mottled red-orange with a lighter belly. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view: a rounded mottled red back, both translucent wings spread wide, and two small tail fins at the bottom. There are no eyes, mouth or face. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is a small red-and-blue shape about a quarter of a cell across, far smaller than the human, consistent with 'bird-sized'. At normal play (32 px/cell) it is only a few red pixels, barely visible beside the human and the rat.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the face head-on: mouth, teeth and the eye row toward the camera.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back and tail fins only, with no eyes or mouth.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are body views from the game camera; none is an overhead plan.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Measured spread is 5%; the facings look the same size in the panel.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The same red-orange wet skin, pale belly, blue translucent wings and small tail-fin pair appear in every view. The wings stick out sideways on south and north and sweep back in the east profile, so they turn correctly with the body.

SIGNATURE.seen: The limbless body, six eyes, two translucent wings and the smaller tail-fin pair are all legible.

ALIEN.seen: The nearest body is a fish, but six eyes, membranous bat-like wings and a toothy amphibian face make it read as alien, not a recoloured fish.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) six eyes: present (a row of six on south, several on east). 2) translucent wings: present (veined, see-through pale blue). 3) a smaller pair of tail fins: present (a forked pair on east and north, tips visible on south).

CANON.seen: Bird-sized limbless body, big compared with its wings, with no legs: yes. Solid red body with a lighter belly and contrasting light-blue translucent wings: yes. Large mouth with red tongue and sharp teeth plus an eye cluster: yes. Tendril stub under the jaw: yes. Realistic wet skin with no outlines: yes. Not a bird, bat, mynock or flat ray, and the wings are not opaque: yes.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, realistic wet skin and membrane texture with no heavy keyline. The face is grotesque, not cute.

OURS.seen: Bespoke painted art drawn from the description; not a vanilla animal or another mod's.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on the checkerboard; no shadow or backdrop.

SCALE.seen: About a quarter of a cell beside the human, which fits 'bird-sized juvenile'.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px/cell it is a few red pixels with no readable wings or shape.

WINGS_FOLDED.seen: The grounded sprite has its wings spread wide on every facing, though they are symmetric.

findings.seen: At 32 px/cell the creature is a tiny red smudge; the wings and body shape are not distinguishable.
findings.quote: legibility at 32 px. Both are polish.
findings.fix: Give the wings and body stronger value contrast against the ground so the silhouette (a red body between two pale wings) reads as two or three bold shapes at small size.
